content.title: World Material Shift | Unbroken Travel Through Environmental Conversion
content.summary: First use stable terrain and continuous tracking to lock the main route, and at a clear impact point, the surrounding world will be replaced by another set of material rules; the main movement, direction and speed are continuous, and finally the readable exit in the new world will be used to prove that it is not an ordinary transition.

quick_start.input_format: Continuously moving subject + original world baseline + single global material change + constant direction and speed + new world end point
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original map workshop, the brass clockwork seeds roll along an indigo river line on the cream paper, and the blue line beacon in the distance remains on the same axis; when reaching the crease apex, the surrounding paper map only transforms once into a deep fabric canyon, the ink line becomes a suture ridge, and the seed route is not reset; the seed approaches the blue line beacon, the fabric canyon is intact, and the opening flat map is not restored
required_anchors: Establish one subject, one travel axis and one ordinary environmental rule before conversion.
Keep subject identity, direction and motion continuous through the decisive instant.
Use passing geometry or material response to prove the new world persists around the same route.
End on continued travel toward a readable destination under the converted rule, not a reset to the opening world.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First use stable terrain and continuous tracking to lock the main route, and at a clear impact point, the surrounding world will be replaced by another set of material rules; the main movement, direction and speed are continuous, and finally the readable exit in the new world will be used to prove that it is not an ordinary transition.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one moving subject to a legible route, perform one global environmental material conversion around that uninterrupted motion, then prove persistence by continuing toward a visible destination under the new world's rules.

invariants.rule: Establish one subject, one travel axis and one ordinary environmental rule before conversion.
invariants.purpose: Creates a baseline against which the world change can be measured.
invariants.ablation_failure: Beginning inside the converted world removes the causal contrast.

invariants.rule: Keep subject identity, direction and motion continuous through the decisive instant.
invariants.purpose: Makes the environment, rather than the traveler, the changing system.
invariants.ablation_failure: A motion reset makes the change read as an unrelated scene cut.

invariants.rule: Convert the environment only once with a visibly global material change.
invariants.purpose: Concentrates the spectacle into one legible causal event.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several unrelated transformations weaken the governing rule.

invariants.rule: Use passing geometry or material response to prove the new world persists around the same route.
invariants.purpose: Provides continuing spatial evidence after the conversion.
invariants.ablation_failure: A single flash frame cannot prove a persistent new world.

invariants.rule: End on continued travel toward a readable destination under the converted rule, not a reset to the opening world.
invariants.purpose: Turns persistence into the terminal result.
invariants.ablation_failure: Returning to the original environment cancels the conversion consequence.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: rocky alpine ridge and dirt jump
the source rider wardrobe and bicycle
the exact cliff-to-glass spectacle and framing
